title: A member who left and comes back through an Excel import gets his new plan but stays hidden as archived
what: When the owner imports a list and a row is a member the gym archived earlier, the import screen says "Already a member (name, archived)". The plan and payment on that row are still saved to him, but he is never brought back from the archive, whichever duplicate choice the owner picks. So a returning member has a paid, running plan, yet he is missing from the Members list, the Active members and ending-soon tiles, and every message group, while his money shows in Collections.
expected: A row that brings a current plan for an archived member either brings that member back (and says so on the import screen) or holds the plan back and asks the owner first.
who: owners bringing back members who left, through an import
how_often: every imported row with a plan for an archived member
fix_line: When an imported plan is still running, bring the archived member back and say so on the import screen

title: On a new phone or laptop, a long-running gym is shown the Get started list again, with steps it finished long ago undone
what: Which set-up steps are ticked, and whether the owner hid the Get started card, is kept only in the browser where it happened. When the owner changes phone, uses a new laptop or the browser is cleared, Today shows Get started again for a gym that has run for months: "Add your staff", "Set your gym timings", "Print the check-in poster" and the online step read as not done, and the menu ring counts them short. Staff and poster can only be ticked again by hand; timings only after opening that screen. The logo step is already a finding; this is the rest of the list.
expected: The set-up state belongs to the gym, not the browser: steps the records can show (staff added, timings saved, page published) tick from the server, and hiding the card or a hand tick is kept with the gym so every device agrees.
who: owners who change phone, use a second device or clear the browser
how_often: every new device or cleared browser
fix_line: Keep the set-up ticks and the hidden choice with the gym on the server, and tick staff and timings from the records

title: Aadhaar and PAN numbers brought in before the 23 Oct rule are still kept
what: Since 23 Oct 2026 the member import leaves out Aadhaar and PAN numbers: a whole column is dropped and a number inside notes or an extra detail is cut out. The import already worked about a week before that. Nothing was ever run over members brought in earlier, and the rule is used only while a file is being imported, so any gym that imported before the rule still has those numbers in its member notes and extra details, with no way to find or remove them except by hand. How many gyms imported in that week was not checked.
expected: A one-time clean-up runs the same rule over every member already in the gym (or at least lists the members whose notes hold an ID number), so old imports meet the same privacy rule as new ones.
who: gyms that imported a member list before 23 Oct 2026, and their members
how_often: once per such gym, stays until cleaned by hand
fix_line: Run the Aadhaar and PAN clean-up once over members already saved, and tell the owner what was removed

title: A brand-new gym's bell counts up to two weeks of MettleUp messages sent before it joined as new
what: A browser that has never opened the bell counts every MettleUp message of the last 14 days as new, with the orange number. For an owner who signed up today, that includes announcements such as 'we added X' written for gyms that already used MettleUp, about things that were in the app from this owner's first minute. The gym's own alerts use one day for the same first look.
expected: On a first look, only messages sent after the gym was made count as new; older ones can sit in the list without the new mark.
how_often: first days of every new gym, whenever HQ sent something in the 14 days before
fix_line: Start the first-look window at the later of 14 days ago and the day the gym was made

items.reason: Web panel logic: no install package, sideload, Play package, watch or phone version split here. The service worker uses the network first, so a fresh load gets the newest logic. The bell moved its seen time to one per branch and copies the old shared one once, keeping it for an older tab; the help box accepts an older server without replies. A tab left open across a deploy keeps the old logic and is never told to reload (same fault as FN-B-time-panel-assistant-01).

Trial and plan end: the banner follows the server dates (grace, basic, read-only), but the plan-end reminder needs online paying on (FN-L14-panel-logic-1-02). Leap day: a 29 Feb birthday is wished on 28 Feb in other years; month adding clamps to month end. Year end: the financial year runs 1 Apr to 31 Mar and growth months cross the year; GST rate is chosen by the day the money came. The day is India day, but Today news uses the device clock (FN-A5-panel-logic-1-1-01). Member leaves and returns: an import gives an archived member a plan but keeps him archived (new 01). Owner changes phone: the Get started list comes back undone (new 02). Staff leaves: Your questions stays in the browser (FN-A5-panel-logic-1-3-03). Gym pause: no pause state exists in this area. Not opened for 6 months: the bell first-look windows are 1 and 14 days, nothing piles up.

Rules added later: Aadhaar and PAN strip (23 Oct) applies only to new imports; the per-branch bell seen time copies the old one for existing users; Get started steps added later (timings, online) also show to gyms that finished the older list.
The bell has a path (old seen time carried over). The Aadhaar rule has none: it runs only during an import and no migration touches saved members.
Rule applied: no path for members imported before 23 Oct = finding 03.

New marks in this area: the bell number for gym alerts (first look = last day), MettleUp messages (first look = last 14 days, even before the gym existed), and the set-up ring and Get started card, which a new device shows to an old gym.
Rule applied: messages from before the gym joined marked new (04); finished set-up steps shown as to-do on a new device (02).
